info.title: Ghotok API
info.description: REST API for ghotok.com.bd. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for authenticated routes and `X-Lang: bn|en` to choose the language of error messages. Errors look like `{ error, code, fields, fieldCodes }`.
